home.heading: Bus and train tickets in Uzbekistan
home.intro: Tell us the journey. A person here buys the ticket and sends you the PDF.
home.refund: We buy your ticket after your money arrives, not before. If the berth is gone by then we offer you the next departure, or refund everything including our fee.

footer.fee: Our fee is 10%, always shown as its own line.
footer.cards: We never ask for card numbers and never will.
